evidence.supports: brms parameterizes group-level covariance through standard deviations and an LKJ correlation prior.
brm transforms user model information into Stan code/data, then post-processes fitted results in brms.
Kidney example marginal effects show age, sex, disease, and age-by-sex population-level predictors.
brms can pass priors to Stan, but meaningful prior choice remains analyst responsibility.
The package comparison table records broad brms model support and remaining feature limits.
The conclusion positions brms as a flexible Stan-backed interface while preserving Bayesian workflow responsibilities.
